mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_class_week (year, month, week, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{year}, #{month}, #{week}, #{mon}, #{tue}, #{wed}, #{thu}, #{fri}, #{sat}, #{sun}, #{centerCode}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT map.class_key AS classKey, uc.unit_key AS unitKey, uc.unit_name AS unitName FROM erp_class_unit_map map JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON map.unit_key = uc.unit_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_time_table (yy, mm, dayname, period_no, start_time, end_time, class_key, unit_key, grade_key, user_code, created_at, time_table_key, center_code) values (#{yy}, #{mm}, #{dayname}, #{periodNo}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{classKey}, #{unitKey}, #{gradeKey}, #{userCode}, SYSDATETIME(), #{timeTableKey}, #{centerCode});
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_time_table SET yy = #{dto.yy}, mm = #{dto.mm}, dayname = #{dto.dayname}, period_no = #{dto.periodNo}, start_time = #{dto.startTime}, end_time = #{dto.endTime}, class_key = #{dto.classKey}, unit_key = #{dto.unitKey}, grade_key = #{dto.gradeKey}, user_code = #{dto.userCode}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
mapper.select: SELECT t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, c.class_type AS classType, c.class_key AS classKey, t.center_code AS centerCode, t.user_code AS userCode, cf.fee AS classFee FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code c ON c.class_key = CASE WHEN t.class_key = 'COM' THEN ta.class_key ELSE t.class_key END LEFT JOIN erp_class_fee_map cf ON cf.class_key = c.class_key AND cf.center_code = t.center_code WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND ta.student_id = #{studentId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_attendance (student_id, attendance_key, time_table_key, center_code, week, yy, mm, created_at) SELECT #{studentId} AS student_id, 'before' AS attendance_key, #{timeTableKey} AS time_table_key, #{centerCode} AS center_code, w.week AS week, #{yy} AS yy, #{mm} AS mm, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS created_at FROM (VALUES ('ju_1'), ('ju_2'), ('ju_3'), ('ju_4')) AS w(week) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_student_attendance sa WHERE sa.student_id = #{studentId} AND sa.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.week = w.week);

INSERT INTO erp_monthly_score (question1, question2, question3, question4, question5, question6, question7, question8, student_id, yy, mm, time_table_key, created_at) VALUES (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, #{studentId}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{timeTableKey}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT time_table_key AS timeTableKey, period_no AS periodNo, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, yy AS yy, mm AS mm, dayname AS dayname, tt.class_key AS classKey, tt.unit_key AS unitKey, cc.class_type AS classType, cc.class_name AS className, uc.unit_name AS unitName, G.grade_key AS gradeKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName FROM erp_time_table tt LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON tt.unit_key = uc.unit_key LEFT JOIN erp_grade_code g ON tt.grade_key = g.grade_key WHERE yy = #{year} AND mm = #{month} AND user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY dayname, period_no

SELECT st.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, tta.week AS week FROM erp_time_table_assign tta JOIN erp_student st ON tta.student_id = st.student_id WHERE tta.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} ORDER BY st.student_name

SELECT tt.id as timeTableId, tt.time_table_key as timeTableKey, tt.period_no as periodNo, tt.start_time as startTime, tt.end_time as endTime, tt.yy as yy, tt.mm as mm, tt.dayname as dayname, cc.class_name as className, uc.unit_name as unitName, g.grade_name as gradeName FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE tt LEFT JOIN erp_grade_code g ON tt.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON tt.unit_key = uc.unit_key LEFT JOIN erp_user u ON tt.user_code = u.user_code WHERE tt.yy = #{year} and tt.mm = #{month} and tt.period_no = #{periodNo} and tt.dayname = #{dayname} and tt.user_code = #{userCode}

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, s.grade_key AS gradeKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName, ta.class_key AS classKey, c.class_name AS className, ta.unit_key AS unitKey, uc.unit_name AS unitName FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_student s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code c ON ta.class_key = c.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON ta.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND t.user_code = #{userCode} AND t.class_key = 'COM'

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, s.grade_key AS gradeKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName, ta.class_key AS classKey, c.class_name AS className, ta.unit_key AS unitKey, uc.unit_name AS unitName FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_student s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code c ON ta.class_key = c.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON ta.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm} AND t.user_code = #{userCode} AND t.class_key = 'COM'

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.app_token AS appToken, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, tc.time_table_ym AS ym, t.class_key AS classKey, t.unit_key AS unitKey, sa.week AS week, sa.in_time AS inTime, sa.out_time AS outTime, ac.attendance_name AS attendanceName, sa.is_before_send AS isBeforeSend, sa.is_after_send AS isAfterSend, r.absence_date AS absenceDate, r.remedial_date AS remedialDate, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, s.center_code AS centerCode
FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE t JOIN ERP_TIME_TABLE_CODE tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key JOIN ERP_TIME_TABLE_ASSIGN ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN ERP_STUDENT s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_STUDENT_ATTENDANCE sa ON s.student_id = sa.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_ATTENDANCE_CODE ac ON sa.attendance_key = ac.attendance_key LEFT JOIN ERP_REMEDIAL r ON s.student_id = r.student_id AND t.time_table_key = r.time_table_key WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.week = #{week}

SELECT CASE #{week} WHEN 'ju_1' THEN bc.ju_1 WHEN 'ju_2' THEN bc.ju_2 WHEN 'ju_3' THEN bc.ju_3 WHEN 'ju_4' THEN bc.ju_4 ELSE bc.ju_1 END AS content, bc.before_class_key AS beforeClassKey, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, tc.time_table_label AS timeTableLabel, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_before_class bc JOIN erp_time_table t ON bc.class_key = t.class_key AND bc.unit_key = t.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON t.user_code = u.user_code JOIN erp_time_table_code tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key WHERE t.unit_key = #{unitKey} AND t.class_key = #{classKey} AND t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}

SELECT * FROM erp_remedial r JOIN erp_student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_user u ON r.user_code = u.user_code WHERE r.user_code = 'DAE001cos' AND substring(r.absence_date, 1, 4) = #{year} AND substring(r.absence_date, 6, 2) = #{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_remedial SET action = #{action}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE remedial_key = #{remedialKey}
UPDATE erp_remedial SET remedial_date = #{remedialDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE remedial_key = #{remedialKey}
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, t.time_table_key, mr.feedback, mr.bottom_comment, mr.is_send, ms.question1, ms.question2, ms.question3, ms.question4, ms.question5, ms.question6, ms.question7, ms.question8 FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key LEFT JOIN erp_monthly_score ms ON ms.time_table_key = t.time_table_key AND ms.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_monthly_result mr ON mr.time_table_key = t.time_table_key AND mr.student_id = ta.student_id WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_monthly_score SET question1 = #{score.question1}, question2 = #{score.question2}, question3 = #{score.question3}, question4 = #{score.question4}, question5 = #{score.question5}, question6 = #{score.question6}, question7 = #{score.question7}, question8 = #{score.question8}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND yy = #{yy} AND mm = #{mm}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_monthly_result (top_comment, bottom_comment, feedback, is_send, yy, mm, student_id, time_table_key, created_at) VALUES (#{topComment}, #{bottomComment}, #{feedback}, #{isSend}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{student.studentId}, #{timeTable.timeTableKey}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_monthly_result SET top_comment = #{topComment}, bottom_comment = #{bottomComment}, feedback = #{feedback}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT CASE c.class_type WHEN '1' THEN 'S' WHEN '2' THEN 'I' ELSE c.class_type END AS gubun, CASE t.dayname WHEN 'mon' THEN '월' WHEN 'tue' THEN '화' WHEN 'wed' THEN '수' WHEN 'thu' THEN '목' WHEN 'fri' THEN '금' WHEN 'sat' THEN '토' WHEN 'sun' THEN '일' ELSE t.dayname END AS dayname, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR (5), t.start_time, 108), ':', '') AS stime, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR (5), t.end_time, 108), ':', '') AS etime, t.mm, c.class_name + ' ' + u.unit_name AS note FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_time_table_code tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code c ON t.class_key = c.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code u ON t.unit_key = u.unit_key WHERE ta.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm}
order by stime ASC

SELECT cc.class_type AS classType, t.yy AS yy, t.mm AS mm, cc.class_name AS className, uc.unit_name AS unitName, t.dayname AS dayname, t.start_time AS startTime, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON t.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON t.user_code = u.user_code WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
